title: A Terminal for the Machine
author: W. M. Almeida
blurb: Mirabel Ravensworth, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
